summary_en: Cancellation of 4,427 treasury shares (0.1% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) effective 2026-06-30. Triggered by stock-exchange merger with HEROZ Corp; Vario Secure will cancel all treasury holdings immediately before HEROZ acquires all issued shares.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Vario Secure Inc. resolved on 2026-06-16 to cancel all treasury shares held as of the reference time (immediately before HEROZ Corp acquires all issued shares), in accordance with the stock-exchange agreement signed on 2026-04-14 between Vario Secure and HEROZ. The cancellation will be effective 2026-06-30. As of 2026-05-31, Vario Secure held 4,427 treasury shares out of 4,544,461 issued shares (0.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury). The cancellation is mandatory under the terms of the stock-exchange contract and will occur before HEROZ completes its acquisition of all issued shares on 2026-06-30.
